blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Narrative extraction allows us to identify online hate narratives, supporting the construction of rigorous detection systems. Existing computational approaches, however, are limited in precision as they rely on semantic representations, which tend to capture only surface-level meaning. To detect more precise and interpretable narratives, we present an extraction pipeline that represents narratives as entity–evaluation pairs. Narratives are extracted using a Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning process that extends Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis, identifying the aspect, classifying its judgement type as the basis for evaluation, and deriving the evaluation accordingly. Extracted narratives are then clustered using Leiden, following which clusters are resolved to an intended level of granularity through an LLM-guided refinement process. We illustrate this narrative pipeline with English Reddit comments from 2024 that criticize Taylor Swift, analysing a representative cluster that exhibits hate speech patterns to demonstrate its interpretive value.
blocks.zh: 叙事提取让我们能够识别网上仇恨叙事,支持构建严格的侦测系统. 然而,现有的计算方法由于依赖于语义表达法,所以在精确度上是有限的,因为语义表达法往往只捕捉到表层意义. 为了发现更准确和可解释的叙述,我们提出了一种提炼管道,它代表叙述作为实体-评价对。 叙述法使用一种大语言模型推理程序进行提取,该推理程序扩展了基于视角的感知分析,确定了这一方面,将其判断类型归类为评价的基础,并据此得出评价。 然后利用莱顿将摘录的叙述分组,然后通过LLM制导的精细化过程,将说明分组解决到预定的颗粒度水平。 我们用2024年批评泰勒·斯威夫特(Taylor Swift)的英国Reddit评论来说明这一叙事程序,分析一个展示仇恨言论模式的有代表性的集群,以展示其解释价值。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Narrative detection can serve as an important tool for understanding how online discourse spreads and shapes attitudes over time, with particular relevance to online hate, which can emerge from sustained narratives that accumulate gradually across seemingly harmless posts [ 2 ] . For instance, narrative similarity has helped identify coordinated user networks, with the disseminated narratives examined to distinguish the agendas of different user groups [ 19 ] . More broadly, this illustrates the potential of narrative detection to reveal patterns of harmful online activity, since hate narratives can similarly accumulate and spread through networks of users. However, many existing detection methods built on semantic similarity tend to capture only surface-level patterns and may struggle to identify narratives that rely on indirect or implicit language. We therefore propose a framework that uses LLMs to extract and aggregate online narratives. This framework can help capture how narratives shape audience perceptions of social entities, supporting more effective platform governance.
blocks.zh: 叙事侦测可以作为一个重要工具,用以了解网络言论如何随时间推移传播和塑造态度,尤其与网络仇恨有关,而在线仇恨可以从持续叙事中产生,这些叙事在看似无害的帖子上逐渐积累[2]. 例如,叙述相似性有助于确定协调的用户网络,并审查传播的叙述,以区别不同用户组的议程[19]。 更广泛地说,这说明了叙述式检测揭示有害的在线活动模式的潜力,因为仇恨叙事同样可以通过用户网络积累和传播。 然而,许多建立在语义相似性上的现有检测方法往往只捕捉表层图案,可能难以识别依赖间接或隐含语言的叙事. 因此,我们建议建立一个框架,利用法学硕士来提取和汇总在线叙述。 这个框架可以帮助捕捉叙事如何塑造观众对社会实体的看法,支持更有效的平台治理.

blocks.en: Narratives are characterizations of individuals, groups, or organizations. When clustered into broader patterns, narratives form meta-narratives: overarching storylines that reflect underlying assumptions and beliefs [ 23 , 3 , 17 ] . Building on this, we introduce our narrative extraction pipeline, which identifies entity-specific narratives by combining aspect-based sentiment analysis with judgement frame analysis. These narratives are then clustered using graph-based community detection and structured LLM reasoning to surface a higher-level landscape of meta-narratives. We demonstrate this pipeline on celebrity discourse, given its high volume and the associated risks of online bullying and reputational harm. Specifically, we apply it to English Reddit comments from 2024 discussing Taylor Swift. Beyond this application, the pipeline can be adapted to other social categories where online hate detection might be a concern.
blocks.zh: 叙述是对个人、团体或组织的定性。 组合成更广泛的图案时,叙事形成元叙述:反映基础假设和信仰的总体故事情节[23,3,17]. 在此基础上,我们引入了我们的叙述性提炼管道,通过将基于方面的情绪分析和判断框架分析相结合,确定具体实体的叙述。 这些叙事然后通过基于图表的社区检测和结构化的LLM推理来组合起来,以表露一个更高层次的元叙事景观. 以及网络欺凌和名誉伤害的风险。 具体来说,我们把它应用于2024年英国Reddit的评论中,讨论泰勒·斯威夫特. 除了这一应用之外,管道还可以适应网上仇恨检测可能令人关切的其他社会类别。

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: Entity Extraction and Resolution.
blocks.zh: 实体采掘和决议。

blocks.en:
Entity extraction and resolution are typically addressed by separate models, from statistical and deep learning models for extraction [ 14 ] to similarity-based matching, blocking, and clustering for
resolution [ 4 ] . Recent advances show that LLMs can perform extraction directly, achieving performance comparable to fully supervised baselines and outperforming them in low-resource and few-shot settings [ 26 ] . This motivates our investigation into whether a single LLM can also perform resolution reliably, and do so jointly with extraction.
blocks.zh:
实体提取和解析通常通过单独的模型处理,从统计模型和深层学习模型进行提取[14],到基于相似性的匹配、阻断和集群,用于
决议[4] 最近的进展表明,LLMS可以直接进行提取,实现与完全监督的基线相当的性能,并在资源少和镜头少的环境下取得优异成绩[26]. 这促使我们调查单一的LLM是否能够可靠地进行解析,并与提取物联合进行。

blocks.en: Narrative Extraction.
blocks.zh: 叙述性采掘。

blocks.en: Existing computational approaches to narrative analysis often focus on identifying what narratives exist, without considering how they are framed, limiting the precision of narrative extraction [ 1 , 25 ] . Such approaches typically rely on semantic representations that capture surface-level similarity, which can produce outputs that are difficult to interpret [ 15 ] . Previous work has attempted to address this by adding additional structure to clusters, such as classifying narratives into predefined story types [ 18 ] . However, the reliance on manual annotation limits the scalability of such approaches. By deriving discourse structure from theory rather than inferring it after clustering, we extract narratives more precisely and interpretably.
blocks.zh: 现有叙述分析的计算方法往往侧重于确定存在哪些叙述,而不考虑其框架如何,限制了叙述提取的精确性[1,25]. 此类方法通常依赖于能捕捉表层相似性的语义表达,这种表达可以产生难以解释的输出[15]. 以前的工作试图通过在集群中添加额外的结构来解决这个问题,例如将叙事分类为预先定义的故事类型[18]. 然而,对人工说明的依赖限制了这类方法的可扩展性。 通过从理论中推导出论述结构,而不是在分组后推断出来,我们取出叙述更为精确和解释.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Pipeline Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 管道概况

blocks.en: Figure 1 illustrates our three-stage pipeline. Given an input document, we identify entities and resolve them to their canonical forms (Section 3.2 ). For each resolved entity, we then extract narrative features that characterize how the entity is portrayed within the document (Section 3.3 ). Finally, these features are grouped into buckets and clustered using community detection. The resulting clusters are then refined with an LLM to produce coherent meta-narratives (Section 3.4 ). We applied our pipeline to the “Exorde Social Media One Month 2024” dataset [ 7 ] , analysing English Reddit comments in the Entertainment category. We focused our analyses on “Taylor Swift”, one of the top extracted entities. String matching on “Taylor” or “Swift” yielded 13,812 candidate records.
blocks.zh: 图1显示了我们的三阶段管道。 根据一份投入文件,我们确定各实体,并按其分类形式予以解决(第3.2节)。 然后,我们为每一个已解决的实体提取说明性特征,说明该实体在文件中如何描绘(第3.3节)。 最后,这些特征被分组为桶,并采用社区检测法进行分组. 然后用LLM改进由此产生的集群,以产生连贯的元描述(第3.4节)。 我们将我们的管道应用于“Exorde Social Media One Month 2024”数据集[7],分析Entertainment类英文Reddit的评论。 我们的分析重点是“Taylor Swift”,这是最先进的实体之一。 在“Taylor”或“Swift”上进行匹配,产生了13 812份候选人记录。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Narrative Pipeline Logic.
blocks.zh: 图1:叙述性管道逻辑。

blocks.en: 3.2 Entity Recognition and Resolution
blocks.zh: 3.2 实体的确认和决议

blocks.en: Each comment is passed to an LLM, which extracts the list of entities it contains using a single prompt. For each entity, the LLM records its reference (the form in which it appears in the text) and determines its country of residence, along with a category (e.g., individual, group, or organisation), which together support resolving the entity to its canonical form. Resolving entities to a canonical form reduces fragmentation from variations in naming, abbreviations, and indirect references, forming coherent entity groups for downstream narrative analysis. Following this process, the 13,812 candidate records identified in Section 3.1 were filtered down to 6,715.
blocks.zh: 每条评论都会传递给一个LLM,它会用一个提示来提取它包含的实体列表. 对于每个实体,LLM记录其参考(文本中出现的形式)并确定其居住国,以及一个类别(如个人、团体或组织),这些类别共同支持解决该实体的犬类形式。 将实体溶解为舟形可以减少因命名,缩写和间接引用等变化而分化,形成用于下游叙事分析的连贯实体组. 这一过程之后,第3.1节确定的13 812份候选人记录被过滤到6 715份。

blocks.en: 3.3 Narrative Extraction
blocks.zh: 3.3 叙述性采掘业

blocks.en: Narratives are centered on entities—individuals, groups, and organizations—whose actions, attributes, or experiences form the subject of the story. Following Page’s [ 21 ] approach to identifying narratives in short online content, each narrative is defined by two key components: an entity and an evaluation expressed towards that entity. Evaluations capture attitudes conveyed through praise, criticism, or condemnation [ 12 , 20 , 16 ] , shaping audience perception of the entities being discussed [ 21 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 叙述以实体——个人、团体和组织——为中心,它们的行动、属性或经验构成故事的主题。 按照Page的[21]方法,在简短的在线内容中确定叙述,每个叙述都由两个关键部分界定:一个实体和一个针对该实体的评价。 评价抓住了通过赞扬、批评或谴责[12、20、16]表达的态度,塑造了观众对所讨论实体的看法[21、6]。

blocks.en: Evaluations are further characterized by their judgement type [ 12 , 11 ] , which is the basis on which the evaluation is made. We identify ethics (sincerity, honesty, or morality) and capability (skill or dependability) as two dominant judgement types for publicly known entities, aligning with the warmth and competence dimensions of social perception identified by the Stereotype Content Model [ 8 , 5 ] . We also include appearance as a third judgement type, as celebrity and public-figure discourse is heavily shaped by mass-mediated imagery and visual appeal, and appearance-based online hate remains a prevalent yet relatively understudied harm [ 9 ] . A breakdown of judgement type definitions provided to the LLM in the narrative extraction prompt is presented in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 评价的另一个特点是其判断类型[12,11],这是进行评价的依据。 我们把道德(诚实、诚实或道德)和能力(技能或可靠性)确定为众所周知的实体的两种主要判断类型,与陈规定型内容模型[8、5]所确定的社会认知的温和和能力层面保持一致。 我们还将外表列为第三种判断类型, 名人与公众人物的言论, 表1列出了叙述性摘录中提供给LLM的判断类型定义的细目。

blocks.en: Table 1: Judgement Type Definitions in Our Narrative Extraction Prompt
blocks.zh: 表1: " 我们叙述性采掘业 " 中的判决类型定义

blocks.en: Narrative Extraction is performed by prompting an LLM (Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8) with a document-entity pair (entity obtained from Section 3.2 ) and a small set of few-shot examples. In a single generation, the model performs a multi-step reasoning procedure that extends Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) [ 13 ] to uncover the evaluation expressed towards the entity.
blocks.zh: 叙述性采掘是通过提示LLM(Qune3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8)进行,其中文件实体对(实体从第3.2节获得)和一小组几拍的例子. 在一代人中,该模型执行一个多步骤的推理程序,将基于视角的感知分析(ABSA)[13]扩展至揭示向实体表达的评价.

blocks.en: In the first step, the model identifies the aspect—defined as a specific attribute or characteristic of the entity discussed (e.g., leadership). Next, it determines the type of judgement (ethics, capability or appearance) being expressed, if any. This step serves as a useful checkpoint: the presence of a judgement signals that an evaluation is likely being made, reducing both false positives from non-judgemental descriptions and false negatives from subtle, implicit evaluations based on a judgement type. Finally, the LLM assesses the overall evaluation made towards the entity, as well as a sentiment score (on a scale of -2 to 2, for more resolution when monitoring narratives; collapsed to discrete labels of positive, neutral, or negative for bucketing before clustering) reflecting its direction. Thereafter, the LLM condenses the entity, aspect, and evaluation into a single summary field, which can be used for downstream clustering and analyses. The features extracted at this stage are summarized in Table 2 , and an illustrative example of the pipeline outputs is given below.
blocks.zh: 在第一步,该模式确定这一方面——被界定为所讨论的实体(例如领导)的具体属性或特征。 其次,它确定表达的判断类型(道德、能力或外表)。 这一步骤是一个有用的检查点:存在判断信号表明有可能进行评价,既减少了非判断性描述的虚假阳性,又减少了基于判断类型的微妙、隐含的评价的虚假阴性。 最后,LLM评估了对该实体的总体评价,以及反映其方向的情绪分数(在监测叙述时,为更清晰的解析度,在分组前,为正、中或负的离散标签)。 之后,LLM将实体、方面和评价凝聚成一个单一的摘要领域,可用于下游集群和分析。 现阶段所提取的特征摘要见表2,下文举例说明管道产出。

blocks.en: Table 2: Summary of Extracted Outputs in Narrative Detection
blocks.zh: 表2:叙述式检测中摘录的产出摘要

blocks.en: The following comment serves as an input to the narrative extraction pipeline. “Sick of hearing about Taylor Swift and all the lame music coming out.” The pipeline then produces (1) the aspect, music quality ; (2) the judgement type, capability ; (3) the evaluation, lame music coming out ; (4) a negative sentiment toward Taylor Swift; and (5) a summary, Taylor Swift’s music is criticised as lame and unimpressive .
blocks.zh: 以下评论是对叙述性提取管道的投入。 “讨厌听到泰勒·斯威夫特和所有的烂音乐都出来了。” 因此,管道制作(1) 音乐质量、(2) 判断类型、能力、(3) 评估、拙劣的音乐涌现出来、(4) 对泰勒·斯威夫特的负面情绪、(5) 总结,泰勒·斯威夫特的音乐被批评为拙劣和没有印象。

blocks.en: 3.4 Meta-Narrative Extraction
blocks.zh: 3.4 冶金开采

blocks.en: Semantic clustering approaches such as BERTopic group documents by embedding similarity alone [ 10 ] . This is inadequate for narrative clustering, as each cluster must be coherent in both the entity it concerns and the sentiment expressed towards it. We address this by grouping summaries from Section 3.3 into buckets sharing a common entity and sentiment polarity. Summaries within each bucket are embedded and clustered using the Leiden algorithm [ 24 ] , which provides an efficient and scalable approach to community detection for large-scale datasets. Clusters are then labelled and refined through the semantic labelling and cluster refinement stages described below.
blocks.zh: 语义分类方法,如BERTOPIC群文件,单独嵌入相似性[10]. 这不足以进行叙述性分组,因为每个分组都必须在它所关注的实体和对它表达的情绪上保持一致。 我们通过将第3.3节的摘要归为共享一个共同实体和情感两极性的桶来解决这一问题。 每个桶内的摘要采用莱顿算法[24]嵌入和集群,该算法为大型数据集提供了高效和可扩展的社区检测方法. 然后通过下文所述的语义标签和集群完善阶段对集群进行标签和完善。

blocks.en: Semantic Labelling
blocks.zh: 语义标签

blocks.en:
For each cluster, up to 100 centroid-nearest texts are sampled, providing sufficient
representation while remaining within practical LLM input limits. These are passed
to an LLM to produce a cluster title and summary, and the title is embedded to obtain a cluster-level embedding used in downstream refinement.
blocks.zh:
对每个组群,对最多100个最接近的文本进行取样,以提供足够的数据。
在实际LLM输入限度内进行表示。 这些都通过
到 LLM 生成集群标题和摘要,该标题被嵌入以获得用于下游改进的集群级嵌入。

blocks.en: Cluster Refinement
blocks.zh: 集群完善

blocks.en: Leiden yields structurally sound clusters, but two issues may persist: cluster titles may be near-identical when the underlying texts describe similar opinions, or conversely, overly general when a cluster comprises texts spanning distinct subtopics. We address both through a refinement stage, where an LLM determines whether a cluster should be split, if its title is overly general, or merged with another, if their titles are overly similar. Both decisions are governed by a user-supplied natural-language granularity description, ensuring that splitting and merging operate at the intended level of detail.
blocks.zh: 莱顿产生结构健全的集群,但两个问题可能持续存在:当基本文本描述类似意见时,集群标题可能几乎相同;或者相反,当一个集群包含涵盖不同分专题的文本时,则过于笼统。 我们通过一个完善阶段来处理这两个问题,一个LLM决定一个集群是应该分裂,如果其标题过于笼统,还是与另一个集群合并,如果其标题过于相似。 这两项决定都受用户提供的自然语言颗粒性描述的制约,确保分割和合并按预定的详细程度运作。

blocks.en: Cluster Splitting. Clusters with at least six texts become candidates for this phase. We pass these candidates’ title, summary, and a sampled subset of their texts to an LLM alongside the granularity description, to determine whether the cluster is overly general, covering multiple distinct subtopics. Clusters identified as such are sub-clustered using Leiden at a resolution of 2.0 2.0 , above the default resolution, to obtain finer-grained clusters which are then relabelled.
blocks.zh: 集群分裂. 至少有6个文本的分组成为这一阶段的候选组。 我们把这些候选人的头衔、摘要和其文本的样本子集连同颗粒性描述一起传给一个LLM,以确定该组是否过于笼统,涵盖多个不同的分专题。 所认定的集群是使用Leiden在2.02.0的分辨率上方的子集群,以获得精细的加成集群,然后重新贴上标签。

blocks.en: Cluster Merging. We construct a cluster similarity graph where nodes are clusters and edges connect pairs with cosine similarity ≥ 0.75 \geq 0.75 , computed over cluster-level embeddings, comparing each cluster against its 3 nearest neighbors to limit inference cost. Each candidate edge is passed to the LLM with the granularity description, which determines whether the cluster pair is sufficiently similar for merging. Edges deemed sufficiently similar are retained and the rest pruned. Connected components of the resulting graph define merge groups, which are then relabelled in a single LLM call. Pruned edges with cosine similarity ≥ 0.80 \geq 0.80 undergo a relabel call that produces disambiguating titles and summaries, or leaves the pair unchanged if labels are already sufficiently distinct.
blocks.zh: 集群合并. 我们构建一个集群相似度图,其中节点为集群,边缘连接对子,其余弦相似度为 0.75\ geq 0.75,通过集群层嵌入计算,将每个集群与其最近的3个邻国进行比较,以限制推论成本. 每个候选边随颗粒性描述传递给LLM,这决定了集群对子是否足够相似,可以合并. 被认为非常相似的边缘被保留,其余部分被保留。 由此形成的图中的连接组件定义了合并组,这些组随后在一次LLM呼叫中重新贴上标签. 余弦相似度为 0. 80\ geq 0. 80 的边缘, 重复使用标签调用, 生成模糊的标题和摘要, 如果标签已经足够区分, 则保留对称不变 。

blocks.en: 4 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4 结果和讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Performance of Entity Extraction and Resolution
blocks.zh: 4.1 实体采掘和决议的执行情况

blocks.en: A dataset to evaluate the performance of the entity extraction and narrative extraction stages was built by manually coding a total of 90 outputs randomly sampled from the Taylor Swift entity bin, with 30 outputs selected for each judgment type to ensure the reliability of the results. Out of these 90 outputs, mentions of Taylor Swift were accurately identified and assigned to the canonical bin in 89 instances for an accuracy of 98.9%.
blocks.zh: 通过手工编码从泰勒·斯威夫特实体本中随机抽取的总共90项产出,为每个判断类型选择了30项产出,以此来评价实体提取和叙事提取阶段的业绩。 在这90项产出中,有89项准确地指明了泰勒·斯威夫特,并分配给了油箱,准确率为98.9%。

blocks.en: 4.2 Performance of Narrative Extraction
blocks.zh: 4.2 叙述性采掘业的业绩

blocks.en: The 90 sampled outputs in the evaluation dataset from Section 4.1 were then annotated by three human raters, all of whom were trained using a common coding scheme. Two independent human raters coded the dataset separately. A third rater then resolved disagreements between the two coders to establish a human ground-truth dataset against which the LLM’s ratings were compared. The validation was conducted sequentially to mirror the dependency structure of the pipeline, where each feature was validated only when its predecessor was correctly identified (Figure 1 ). For example, sentiment was only assessed within correctly identified evaluations. This ensures that at each stage the LLM and the human rater are assessing the same narrative, and feature-level metrics should be interpreted accordingly as conditioned on correct upstream identification.
blocks.zh: 第4.1款评价数据集的90项抽样产出随后由3名人员评分员作了说明,他们都通过共同编码计划接受了培训。 两个独立的人类测算器分别编码了数据集. 第三个评级人随后解决了两个编码人之间的分歧,以建立一个人地真相数据集,将LLM的评级进行比较。 验证是按顺序进行的,以反映管道的依赖结构,每个特性只有在正确识别其前身时才得到验证(图1)。 例如,只在正确确定的评价中评估了情绪。 这就确保了在每一阶段,LLM和人类评分器都在评估同样的叙述,特征级的衡量标准应相应地解释为以正确的上游识别为条件。

blocks.en: Table 3: Results for Entity, Aspect and Evaluation.

blocks.en: Subjective categorical variables (e.g., evaluation, aspect) were evaluated differently from fixed-category variables (e.g., judgement, sentiment). For the former, we treat disagreements between coders as natural variation in human interpretation rather than error [ 22 ] , instead assessing whether the LLM’s output constituted a defensible, textually supported interpretation. Where disagreement remained, a third coder made the final call. Fixed-category variables, by contrast, were independently coded by annotators and compared directly against the LLM’s outputs.
blocks.zh: 对主观的绝对变量(如评价、方面)的评价不同于固定类别的变量(如判断、情绪)。 对前者来说,我们把编码者之间的分歧视为人类解释的自然变异,而不是错误[22],相反,我们评估LLM的产出是否构成一种站得住脚的文字支持的解释。 在分歧仍然存在的地方,第三个编码员发出了最后呼吁。 相比之下,固定类别的变量是由注释者独立编码的,直接与LLM的产出进行比较。

blocks.en: Within correctly identified entities (N = 89), aspect had an accuracy of 75% (Table 3 ). Within accurately identified aspects and judgements (N = 65), evaluation accuracy was 92.5%. It should be noted that feature-level metrics are computed on a shrinking denominator at each stage, which presents an optimistic picture of accuracy in isolation. To provide a holistic estimate of overall performance, we also report end-to-end accuracy by counting narratives where all features are correctly identified: of 90 narratives extracted across our sample of entities, 68.9% were fully accurately extracted.
blocks.zh: 在正确确定的实体(N=89)中,准确度为75%(表3)。 在准确确定的方面和判断(N=65)内,评价准确度为92.5%。 应当指出的是,每个阶段的特征水平衡量标准都是根据一个不断缩小的分母计算的,它孤立地提供了准确性的乐观图景。 为了全面估计总体业绩,我们还报告端到端的准确性,计算出所有特征都正确识别的叙述:在我们抽样实体的90个叙述中,68.9%完全准确提取。

blocks.en: For judgement type, the LLM demonstrated good classification performance, achieving a macro-averaged F1 score of 1.0 1.0 across the three judgement type categories. Interrater reliability for sentiment ratings was assessed with a two-way absolute agreement, single-measure intraclass correlation coefficient. Results indicated excellent reliability between the LLM and ground truth, ICC = .93 \text{ICC}=.93 , 95% CI [ .89 , .96 ] [.89,.96] , p < .001 p<.001 .
blocks.zh: 对于判断类型,LLM表现出良好的分类性能,在三种判断类型中实现了1.0 1.0的宏观平均F1分. 以双向绝对一致、单一计量的阶级内部关联系数来评估情绪评级的介质可靠性。 结果表明,LLM和地面真相之间的可靠程度,ICC=.93\text{ICC}=93,95%CI [89,.96] [89,96],p < 001 p < 001]。

blocks.en: While the pipeline demonstrates reasonable performance, the presence of erroneous features suggests that conclusions drawn from individual narrative extractions should be interpreted cautiously. We anticipate that genuinely recurring narratives will consolidate into meaningful meta-narratives, while erroneous narratives, being idiosyncratic, are unlikely to cluster consistently enough to form a meta-narrative. The metrics reported here should therefore be interpreted as a preliminary performance benchmark rather than a definitive constraint on the pipeline’s utility.
blocks.zh: 虽然管道显示出合理的性能,但错误特征的存在表明,从个别叙述性摘录中得出的结论应当谨慎解释。 我们预计,真正重复的叙述将合并成有意义的元叙述,而错误的叙述,作为典型的,不太可能一致地组合成元叙述。 因此,此处报告的衡量标准应解释为初步业绩基准,而不是对管道用途的决定性限制。

blocks.en: 4.3 Performance of Meta-Narrative Extraction
blocks.zh: 4.3 Meta-Narrative采掘业的业绩

blocks.en:
Figure 2 presents a meta-narrative recovered by the
pipeline. The example illustrates the pipeline’s ability to recover semantically coherent opinion clusters. Although the constituent comments draw on distinct points of comparison—her “girly” image, her body shape, and comparisons to other artists—they converge on a shared narrative that Taylor lacks sex appeal despite being objectively attractive. This offers an appropriately granular view of how she is perceived, neither fragmenting into narrow sub-areas such as commentary on a single physical feature, nor collapsing into broad, undifferentiated criticism of her appearance or character. Such thematic specificity could be lost in a broader semantic cluster spanning multiple entities or sentiment polarities. Individual comments in this cluster often read as superficially positive or neutral, prefacing their critique with a compliment, as in “I absolutely love Taylor Swift…” or “Taylor Swift is objectively pretty…”. Evaluated on their surface sentiment alone, such comments might not be flagged by post-level hate detection techniques that assess comments in isolation. It is only once our pipeline extracts the underlying evaluation embedded within each comment, and aggregates it across the cluster, that the broader pattern of characterization becomes visible, along with its potential to shape perception and cause reputational harm over time.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: This paper presented a pipeline for narrative extraction and clustering that facilitates more precise and interpretable narratives. This then provides a useful avenue for online narrative monitoring, supporting efforts to detect and understand hate narratives as they emerge.
blocks.zh: 本文为叙事提取和集群提供了一个管道,便于更精确和可解释的叙事。 这为在线叙事监测提供了一个有用的途径,支持在仇恨叙事出现时发现和理解这些叙事的努力。

blocks.en:
Several limitations suggest directions for future work. First, clustering quality is
bounded by the accuracy of upstream entity and sentiment extraction. Errors at this
stage propagate into bucket composition and cannot be recovered downstream. Second, the labelling and refinement stages are coupled to the behaviour of the underlying LLM. Both model sensitivity and the non-determinism inherent in LLM calls introduce variation in split and merge decisions, and future work should explore guardrails such as confidence thresholds or ensemble voting across runs to improve consistency. Third, the pipeline processes a static corpus, and extending it to support incremental clustering over evolving document streams would be a natural step toward studying long-term opinion dynamics and coordinated narrative activity in social discourse. Finally, there is a need to fully operationalise the detection of hate narratives by defining criteria at the cluster level. Possible methods include identifying clusters with the lowest average sentiment, or identifying cluster labels with concerning semantic indicators.
blocks.zh:
一些限制为今后的工作指明了方向。 首先,分组质量是
以上游实体和情感提取的准确性为界. 此错误
扩散成桶状,无法在下游回收。 第二,标签和完善阶段与基本LLM的行为相结合。 模式敏感性和LLM调用中固有的非定型性都引入了分拆和合并决定的变异,今后的工作应当探索信任阈值或全团横排投票等护栏,以提高一致性. 第三,编审程序将处理静态程序,并扩展程序,支持在不断发展的文件流上逐步集中,这将是研究长期舆论动态和社会言论中协调叙事活动的自然步骤。 最后,有必要通过在集群一级确定标准,使发现仇恨叙事充分发挥作用。 可能的方法包括确定平均情绪最低的集群,或确定带有语义指标的集群标签。
